name: Vessel colors
notes: The little vessel, its shade, the Void Bolt and the nail / soul effects. 1 = void black contour, 2 = mask white, 3 = mask shadow, 4-6 = cloak (dark slate to its lit edge), 7-8 = nail steel, 9 = slash white, a-b = slash pale grey-blue, c-d = void (black-violet and its wisps), e-f = soul light.
